d.ko:
The endless darkness and the somber, long passages of a military complex have become the abode of evil, thousands of blood-thirsty creatures fill its offices, storehouses and mysterious laboratories.
About 1,000 monsters on each map, showing up to 100 monsters simultaneously on one playing screen.
